experience.aboutMe: Welcome to my portfolio! I am someone who loves learning and creating beautiful, functional web applications. I am currently doing an apprenticeship to become a software developer, and I am always looking for new challenges and opportunities to develop my skills. In addition to my apprenticeship, I take online courses to expand my knowledge and learn about new technologies. For example, this year I completed Scrimba's Full Stack Developer course. I am currently learning how to integrate AI into web applications. I am based in Heidelberg, Germany.
